title: agentopt manifest
description: The map from everything tunable (prompts, tool descriptions, generation params) to where it lives in the user's code (.agentopt/manifest.json). Built from wiretap stack traces confirmed by static analysis; entries that cannot be located precisely are marked non-editable rather than guessed.

steps.description: Entry ids of the pipeline steps observed using this model.

file.description: Path relative to project_root. Null when the source is not a file (e.g. database-stored params).

node_path.description: Parser-specific path to the AST node holding the value; consumed by the safe writer of the matching language.

slots.description: Interpolated variable names that any rewrite must preserve exactly.

content_hash.description: sha256 hex of the current static content; drift detection compares this across runs.

editable.description: False when the value cannot be located precisely enough to rewrite safely; such entries receive recommendations instead of edits.

prompt_hashes.description: Runtime prompt hashes observed originating from this entry; links manifest entries to trace events.
